policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV begins directly with 'Straightway', supporting base εὐθέως rather than RP Καὶ εὐθέως.
ASV 'and he that sat' directly represents καὶ ὁ καθήμενος, which RP omits.
ASV 'like an emerald to look upon' directly represents base ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ.
ASV 'thrones' does not distinguish nominative θρόνοι from accusative θρόνους in this verbless construction.
ASV has no second determiner in 'upon the thrones I saw four and twenty elders', supporting the base without RP's added τοὺς.
ASV 'arrayed in white garments' directly represents base ἐν, omitted by WH.
ASV relative 'which' excludes RP's added αὐτοῦ ('his') but does not distinguish neuter ἅ from feminine αἵ.
ASV 'the seven Spirits' directly represents base τὰ, omitted by RP.
ASV 'had' does not preserve the masculine-versus-neuter participial form.
ASV 'a face as of a man' directly represents base τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς; RP lacks both the article and ὡς.
ASV 'each one' is compatible with both καθ᾽ ἓν and ἕκαστον.
ASV 'of them' directly represents base αὐτῶν, omitted by RP.
ASV 'having' does not preserve the masculine-versus-neuter participial form.
In the temporal clause, ASV 'shall give' does not securely distinguish future δώσουσιν from subjunctive δῶσιν.
ASV 'on the throne' can represent either dative τῷ θρόνῳ or genitive τοῦ θρόνου after ἐπί.
ASV 'our Lord and our God' represents base ἡμῶν and has no 'the holy' corresponding to RP's addition.
ASV 'all things' is compatible with both τὰ πάντα and article-less πάντα.
